description: Request of messaging.member.mute (POST /internal/v1/operator/conversations/{conversation_id}/members/{member_id}/mute). The owner receives the request's tenant scope as its tenant; the body never names a tenant.

operation_id.description: HQ's command id; equal to the Idempotency-Key header.

expected_version.description: The resource version the command applies to (VERSION_CONFLICT otherwise); 0 means none yet where allowed.
